clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 3 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 3 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: OEM Average Turnover
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 10 Lakh (s) A Bid Number GEM/2026/B/8211460
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 10 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience Yes Partial | Experience - 2 year (s)
clauses.summary: MSE bidders get a partial relaxation, needing only 2 years of experience.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience Yes Partial | Experience - 2 year (s)
clauses.summary: Startup bidders get a partial relaxation, needing only 2 years of experience.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorisation and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate of turnover must be uploaded with the bid.

clauses.heading: 4. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the stated number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 4. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted for each financial year of experience.

clauses.heading: 5. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid for the last three years.

clauses.heading: 8. Past Performance
clauses.quote: should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 70% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 70% of the bid quantity to government or PSU in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 3 Generic Manufacturer Authorization
clauses.quote: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Authorised distributors must furnish an OEM authorisation certificate with OEM contact details.

clauses.heading: 14 Turnover
clauses.quote: Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: Bidder must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid for the last three years.

clauses.heading: 20 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or (ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value.
clauses.summary: Bidder/OEM must have executed one order of 35%, two of 20%, or three of 15% of estimated bid value in the preceding 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: 20 Past Project Experience
clauses.quote: Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid.
clauses.summary: Satisfactory performance certificates from buyer organisations must be uploaded for the qualifying orders.
